customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in workflow env, marked with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above (TRIVY_VERSION in ci.yml).

packageRules.description: Never group unrelated packages into one PR - each update stays individually reviewable.
Majors get a longer cooldown and explicit dashboard approval before a branch is even created.
Digest-only updates of already-pinned images carry no new version, so the age gate does not apply.
Base images ship inside the release images, so updating them is a fix(deps): it cuts a patch release instead of waiting for the next feat or fix.
procrastinate's schema changes are applied by Alembic revisions that name its migration files, so an update may need a revision written by hand. Never automerged, and the PR says what to check.
prBodyNotes: :warning: **procrastinate's schema is migrated by Alembic.** If this release ships new migration files, `tests/test_jobs.py` fails and lists them; the update then needs an Alembic revision applying them — see the docstring of `backend/alembic/versions/v2w3x4y5z6a7_procrastinate_schema.py`.

packageRules.description: Backend runtime dependencies ship in the image too. Dev dependency groups stay chore(deps). npm `dependencies` in frontend-next/ already get fix from config:recommended.
